response.rationale: The item is a final-sale clearance item (final_sale == True), which triggers RET-012 (priority 100), the highest-priority applicable rule, making the item ineligible for return. Although the customer describes a defect, the facts show defective == False, so RET-020 does not apply; and RET-020 requires final_sale == False in any case.
